h: Standing Equally Before Hashem in the Coming Redemption

p: "You are standing today, all of you,
In Tanchuma (on this parshah, 2; Tanchuma Buber, Nitzavim 5):
"Even though I have appointed for you
all of you are equal before Me,
as it says, 'and every man of Yisrael.'"
That is, after it is written
"And Hashem will bring you back to Egypt in ships,"
which is expounded in the Zohar Chadash (there)
that HaKadosh Baruch Hu performed in Egypt,
"As in the days of your going out of the land of Egypt
I will show him wonders," etc.;
just as there it means song,
all the nations of the world will come in ships
and Yisrael will sing a song
(as was explained above in Parshas Savo).
it indicates the middah of Atika;
and it alludes to the first three,
the aspect of the Name Havayah.
That is, that then they will merit
as they merited at the Sea,
as stated (in the Mechilta and elsewhere):
And likewise it is stated (at the end of Taanis, Taanis 31a):
will make a circle dance for the righteous,
וְהוּא יוֹשֵׁב בֵּינֵיהֶם בְּגַן עֵדֶן וְכוּלֵּי
and He will sit among them in Gan Eden," etc.
A circle dance is in a ring,
and in a round thing there are no levels,
שֶׁכָּל אֶחָד שָׁוֶה בַּמִּדָּה אֶל הַמֶּרְכָּז
for each one is equally distant from the center.
וְכָל אֶחָד וְאֶחָד מַרְאֶה בְּאֶצְבָּעוֹ וְכוּלֵּי
"And each and every one points with his finger," etc.:
זֶה ה׳ קִוִּינוּ לוֹ (יְשַׁעְיָה כה, ט)
"This is Hashem, for Whom we hoped" (Yeshayahu 25:9),
And this is what is said here:
"You are standing before Hashem your God,"
that is, that they point with the finger:
"This is Hashem, for Whom we hoped."
that each and every one of Yisrael
and even your woodchopper and your water-drawer,
at the splitting of the Sea:
And this is the purpose of the exiles:
that each and every one of Yisrael merit
that it be "every man of Yisrael."
And likewise the day of Shabbos,
which is a semblance of the World to Come,
one-sixtieth of the World to Come
to be standing before Hashem your God.
there is the revelation of the aspect of Atika,
as is written in the holy Zohar,
and every one of Yisrael can merit
the revelation according to his preparation.
And so they said in the Yerushalmi (Demai 4:1):
"The awe of Shabbos is upon the unlearned person";
attains and merits the holiness of Shabbos;
and through the holiness of Shabbos
one merits the revelation of Atika,
as it will be in the World to Come,
a circle dance for the righteous,

paragraphs.text: Source: Berachos 57b — “חמשה וששה ועשרה סימן: חמשה אחד מששים, אלו הן: אש, דבש, ושבת, ושינה, וחלום. אש — אחד מששים לגיהנם. דבש — אחד מששים למן. שבת — אחד מששים לעולם הבא. …” (Oz Vehadar print, p. 146) — “The numbers five, six, and ten are mnemonics for the categories to follow.
